name: read
description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

file_path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

name: edit
description: Edit a file by replacing exact text. The oldText must match exactly (including whitespace). Use this for precise, surgical edits.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text to find and replace (must match exactly)

newText.description: New text to replace the old text with

file_path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

old_string.description: Exact text to find and replace (must match exactly)

new_string.description: New text to replace the old text with

name: write
description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

file_path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

name: exec
description: Execute shell commands with background continuation. Use yieldMs/background to continue later via process tool. Use pty=true for TTY-required commands (terminal UIs, coding agents).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, kills process on expiry)

pty.description: Run in a pseudo-terminal (PTY) when available (TTY-required CLIs, coding agents)

elevated.description: Run on the host with elevated permissions (if allowed)

name: process
description: Manage running exec sessions: list, poll, log, write, send-keys, submit, paste, kill.

sessionId.description: Session id for actions other than list

keys.description: Key tokens to send for send-keys

hex.description: Hex bytes to send for send-keys

timeout.description: For poll: wait up to this many milliseconds before returning

name: sessions_list
description: List sessions with optional filters and last messages.

name: sessions_history
description: Fetch message history for a session.

name: sessions_send
description: Send a message into another session. Use sessionKey or label to identify the target.

name: sessions_spawn
description: Spawn an isolated session (runtime="subagent" or runtime="acp"). mode="run" is one-shot and mode="session" is persistent/thread-bound. Subagents inherit the parent workspace directory automatically.

resumeSessionId.description: Resume an existing agent session by its ID (e.g. a Codex session UUID from ~/.codex/sessions/). Requires runtime="acp". The agent replays conversation history via session/load instead of starting fresh.

name: subagents
description: List, kill, or steer spawned sub-agents for this requester session. Use this for sub-agent orchestration.

name: session_status
description: Show a /status-equivalent session status card (usage + time + cost when available). Use for model-use questions (📊 session_status). Optional: set per-session model override (model=default resets overrides).

name: web_search
description: Search the web using Brave Search API. Supports region-specific and localized search via country and language parameters. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets for fast research.

country.description: 2-letter country code for region-specific results (e.g., 'DE', 'US', 'ALL'). Default: 'US'.

date_after.description: Only results published after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_before.description: Only results published before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

search_lang.description: Brave language code for search results (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'en-gb', 'zh-hans', 'zh-hant', 'pt-br').

ui_lang.description: Locale code for UI elements in language-region format (e.g., 'en-US', 'de-DE', 'fr-FR', 'tr-TR'). Must include region subtag.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch and extract readable content from a URL (HTML → markdown/text). Use for lightweight page access without browser automation.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to return (truncates when exceeded).
